title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
text: All summer long, the ant worked hard, carrying grains of food to her nest. The grasshopper spent his days singing and playing in the sun. When the ant asked him to help store food for winter, the grasshopper laughed and said there was plenty of time. Autumn came, and still the grasshopper played while the ant kept gathering. Then winter arrived, cold and snowy. The grasshopper had no food and no shelter. He knocked on the ant's door, hungry and shivering, and the ant shared what she had stored away.
